system.notes:
Dagger (d6). 3 Gift Dice — casts Fireball, Bubble, Disguise, and Mine!; can cast a spell and use her dagger in the same turn. Carries at least one healing potion. Protected by loyal minions.

Founder of the Perils & Princesses Society; first Luminary; designer of the Silver Rose Pin; author of the oath — her heart frozen by the Frostbind curse her four friends could not break. Everything since is her proving friendship a lie.

The Choice: she can be fought — or saved, if Amy's Powerful Friendship reaches through the curse. See Morwenna, Frost-Crowned for the final phase either way.
